Theme

faith noun

also the faith, trust in God, trust, in bad faith, good faith

classical

Traupman 152, 312, 158
Vulg. Mc. 5.34
Lact. 4.30 (Lewis & Short)

fidēs, fideī f.

noun, fifth declension

faith, trust

Trust, good faith, belief; in the Church, faith in God, and the faith itself, the Christian religion (Lewis & Short). Bonā fidē, in good faith (Traupman).

Examples

  • Fīlia, fidēs tua tē salvam fēcit: vāde in pāce

    Daughter, your faith has made you well: go in peaceVulg. Mc. 5.34

  • Chrīstusque nōbīs sit cibus, pōtusque noster sit fidēs

    let Christ be our food, and faith our drinkAmbr. hymn. Splendor 21–22

  • Modicae fideī, quārē dubitāstī?

    You of little faith, why did you doubt?Vulg. Mt. 14.31

  • dē fidē malā

    in bad faithTraupman 312

See also God, prayer, baptism.
